I implemented the LRU cache in Swift. All 5 example cases in `node check.mjs` pass, and a 1,000,000-command input with capacity 100,000 finished in about 0.7 s. I didn't get to run the unit tests: the `Testing` module isn't installed on this machine.

**Build workaround:** `build.sh` calls `swiftc` directly instead of `swift build`, because SwiftPM is broken here (it crashes on startup with a missing-symbol error). It also picks the macOS 15 SDK, because the default SDK (26.2) was built for Swif
